design_notes: Serif throughout, hairline rules, two rule weights, single accent colour; no icons or decorative imagery.
Financials table sets the page: right-align all figures, keep the ₹ crore unit in the header, and let the short-term borrowings row carry the accent rule.
Industry snapshot sits as a three-stat strip between paragraphs, not as a boxed callout.

industry_snapshot.after_paragraph: Infrastructure and construction, as the filing defines it, includes power
industry_snapshot.rationale: Three disclosed market-size and contribution figures give the industry section a scannable anchor without inventing growth or composition data the excerpts do not carry.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: One fact runs through the whole document: customer concentration.
pull_quotes.quote: Indian Railways was the company's largest customer, contributing 57% of revenue in Fiscal 2018 [^drhp-p12].
pull_quotes.rationale: A single disclosed number that frames the entire report and cannot be carried by the surrounding prose.

sidebars.body_markdown: The issue is 44,28,000 equity shares of ₹10 face value each, with the price left blank in the filing [^drhp-p29]. The excerpts do not establish how the shares split between a fresh issue and an offer for sale, and no selling shareholder is named [^drhp-p29]. The main object is working capital of ₹1,130 lakhs, about ₹11.3 crore; general corporate purposes is the second object, with the amount undisclosed [^drhp-p48]. Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited is lead manager and Bigshare Services Private Limited is registrar [^drhp-p31]. No independent appraising agency and no monitoring agency are appointed [^drhp-p18].
sidebars.rationale: Condenses the offer mechanics, use of proceeds and intermediaries into one scannable block so the reader can hold the deal terms while reading the rest.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance

tables.after_paragraph: The filing reports in ₹ lakhs. One hundred lakhs make ₹1 crore
tables.footnote: Revenue and net profit after adjustments [^drhp-p27]; profit before interest, depreciation and tax [^drhp-p111]; total assets, long-term borrowings and short-term borrowings [^drhp-p26].
tables.rationale: The five-year restated statement is the spine of the report; a table lets the reader see the falling top line against the steady operating line and the short-term debt build in one glance.
rows: Profit before interest, depreciation and tax
